id.description: Unique. Also the file name in exported bundles.

pdf.description: True when the knowledge area offers it as a download.

origin.description: Where the text came from before the corpus held it.

published.description: The live URL that shows this document, if any.

key.description: Short name a consumer uses for anchors, such as case-<key> on the site.

order.description: Position within its type when a consumer shows a set, such as the case study rail.

stat_key.description: Case study: the headline result, shown in bold.

stat.description: Case study: the rest of the result line after the headline.

short_needs.description: Case study: one line on the problem, for cards and the at-a-glance table.

short_execute.description: Case study: one line on what was done, for cards and the at-a-glance table.

short_observe.description: Case study: one line on how it was measured, for cards and the at-a-glance table.

short_normalize.description: Case study: one line on what happens next, for cards and the at-a-glance table.

x-types.$comment: Extra rules per type, checked by tools/lint.mjs. sections lists the H2 headings a document of that type must have, in order.

faq.$comment: Each H2 is a question and its text is the answer.
